Check on your baby from anywhere at home, with or without Wi-Fi. Stay connected through the app and share access with up to 5 family members.

With 330° pan, 60° tilt and 8× zoom you see every corner and every facial detail, and clear night vision even shows the chest rising and falling. Twins can be watched on a split screen with two feeds.
A 5000mAh battery lets the camera travel with your baby, at home, at a hotel or at the summer house, and it keeps working during power cuts.

Active noise reduction cuts background noise by 20 dB, and the monitor alerts you to crying, room temperature changes and loud sounds. 24/7 recording in the app helps you understand your baby's sleep.

Flip the switch to turn off Wi-Fi and use a private local connection. RSA-1024 and AES-128 encryption keep intruders out, and every recording is protected with a unique key and saved to your local SD card.
The SD card is not included.
